title: grga trace-viz session v1
description: Data format for a retrospective visualization of a single grga (or similar multi-step retrieval + reflection) search session. Consumed by tools/trace-viz/build_html.py to produce a swim-lane HTML. See tools/trace-viz/README.md.

session_version.description: Schema contract version. Bump MAJOR on breaking changes.

title.description: Optional session title shown in the HTML sidebar header.

subtitle.description: Optional short caption under the title (e.g. 'N steps · M families · corpus').

steps.description: One entry per search step in chronological order.

family_order.description: Column order (left to right) for the family lanes.

family_colors.description: family_name -> hex color string. Every family in family_order MUST have a color.

kind_markers.description: kind -> single-char marker glyph used inside the node circle.

kind_labels.description: kind -> human-readable label used in legend and tooltip.

summary.description: Optional pre-rendered content for the sidebar 'summary' section (stats + path features). When present, build_html injects these strings verbatim into the sidebar template.

step.description: 1-based step index. Must be unique and sequential across the session.

family.description: Which query-keyword family this step belongs to. MUST appear in family_order.

kind.description: Step kind. 'antipattern' auto-triggers black outline; 'synthesize' auto-triggers larger radius.

cmd.description: Short command snippet shown as <code> in tooltip. Drop -d path and other noise; keep verb + query.

signal.description: Visible hit signal shown next to the node (e.g. '7 hits', 46, 'empty'). Prefix with '🎯 ' to trigger gold-highlight for a jackpot hit.

decision.description: What the caller decided after this step. Shown in tooltip 'decision' row.

insight.description: Optional lesson / observation. Shown in tooltip 'insight' row. Empty string is fine.
